the cosmogenic $^{40}Ar$ is produced by the $^{39}K(n,p)^{39}Ar$ reaction induced by neutrons produced in the atmosphere, and that the cosmogenic argon is depleted by the factor of $\sim 10$ compared to atmospheric argon.
the $^{40}\text{Ar}$ and the $^{39}Ar$ are produced by muons and neutrons underground and the $^{40}Ar/^{39}Ar $ ratio depends on the depth and the radioactivity level of underground rock.

the $^{40}\text{Ar}/^{39}\text{Ar}$ ratio is a strong function of depth, and the $^{39}$Ar production underground is dominated not by radiogenic production but by stopping negative muons capture on $^{40}$K.
